season.evidence: Stored May-Jun. Search: a mountaineering club lists the NW route as May-Aug; couloir ski/snow ascents reported mid to late May; by mid-late summer the line is loose talus with no snow benefit. Histogram empty in packet.

track.why: May 20 2024: starts and ends at Cedar Creek Trailhead (16/18 m from our pin), crosses Cedar Creek on a log jam, stays west of the creek, climbs a steep snow/ice slope on the north side then steps right onto loose scree to the summit; matches our Cedar Creek / NW couloir text. Logged route "North Ridge-ish". Every other track on the peak starts at Wolf Creek (SW route).

otherTracksConsidered.why: May 31 2009 NW Couloir via Cedar Creek, but the track is partial (starts 3.5 km from the trailhead pin).
Wolf Creek approach via Gardner Meadows.

facts.text: In mid-May the snow on the main climb can be hard, smooth ice; a steep committing section calls for crampons and ideally a second axe.
By late May in warm weather the log over Cedar Creek can be submerged, and a thigh-deep wade is dangerous; one party was nearly swept off.
In mid-May, staying on the west side of Cedar Creek all the way up keeps bushwhacking light.
In mid-May, loose scree beside the icy slope lets you boot-ski down and skip much of the steep hard snow; take crampons off before sliding the lower slope.

notes: Southwest route already has tracks. 2515753 is the only complete in-season Cedar Creek round trip.
